versions.content: EcucDestinationUriPolicy.destinationUriNesting- Contract is set to targetContainer If the attribute EcucDestina- tionUriPolicy.destinationUriNestingContract is set to targetCon- tainer , then the attribute EcucDestinationUriPolicy.container is express- ing the constraints applicable for an EcucContainerDef that wants to become a target for the enclosing EcucDestinationUriDef . For this purpose, the EcucContainerDef needs to follow the structure of EcucDes- tinationUriPolicy.container : • Specific primitive attributes of the EcucContainerDef , in particular – shortName – lowerMultiplicity and one of – upperMultiplicity or – upperMultiplicityInfinite need to be identical to EcucDestinationUriPolicy.container . • Specific aggregations of the EcucContainerDef , in particular – EcucParamConfContainerDef.parameter – EcucParamConfContainerDef.reference – EcucParamConfContainerDef.subContainer for which corresponding elements (identified by a matching pair of shortName s) in the context of the EcucDestinationUriPolicy.container exist, shall be identical to the applicable aggregations of EcucDestinationUriPolicy. container . This rule may be applicable in a recursive manner if EcucDesti- nationUriPolicy.container . subContainer exists. It is allowed that the EcucContainerDef (the target of the URI-based reference) has additional child elements that are not represented in the definition of the EcucDesti- nationUriPolicy .
